intent: Generate new areas using existing Studio screenshots as visual identity references, not edit targets.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one landscape 1536x1024 concept frame for a modular Blender/Roblox horror level.
Primary request: Design a NEW party-supply storeroom directly behind the children's party maze in the reference images. Keep its ordinary, semi-dirty, inexpensive late-1990s indoor birthday venue in an aging middle/lower-income mall identity. Improve the material definition and spatial composition while preserving the cheap low-ceiling boxy backrooms atmosphere.
Input images 1 and 2 are visual identity references, NOT edit targets. Copy the budget scale, yellowed ceiling grid, cheap beige/orange walls and colorful plastic chairs, not the screenshot's exact composition. No HUD.
Scene: a compact low rectangular storeroom. Battered gray metal racks along the left wall hold paper-plate packs, cheap plastic cups, boxed birthday decorations, taped cardboard cartons and deflated balloons. A small old helium cylinder is safely upright by the shelves. On the right, a couple of chipped folding rectangular tables lean against the wall beside stacked red, yellow and green one-piece plastic chairs. A shallow open box contains faded flat cardboard clown/smiley party cutouts, plainly decorations and NOT animatronics. Keep just enough clutter to tell the story, with a generous clear central aisle and believable walkable floor.
Rear left: a clearly open plain orange fire door frames part of the existing orange party room, revealing its black skirting, ugly dark confetti-pattern carpet and one folding table. Rear right: a second closed plain service door suggests modular route potential. No fancy signage.
Materials: cheap faded beige paint, black vinyl skirting, thin worn dull linoleum with a few patched squares and grime only at edges, low yellowed acoustic ceiling tiles and two simple flat rectangular fluorescent fixtures. Minor scuffs, old tape marks and ordinary use; still maintained enough to operate, NOT abandoned for decades.
Camera: human eye level, moderately wide 27mm-like perspective, a strong view down the clear aisle to the two rear doors, one full scene. Moderately stylized polished 3D indie-horror game/Blender concept, chunky reusable assets, medium detail, restrained realistic wear, not a photograph. Readably dim fluorescent lighting, unsettling absence after closing, no fog.
Avoid: upscale mall architecture, luxury hotel styling, high ceilings, coves, marble, velvet, banquettes, palms, designer fixtures, terrazzo, complicated tiny clutter, extreme decay, apocalypse, water/puddles/aquariums/fountains, people, monsters, gore, captions, overlays, logos, watermarks, split-screen or collage.
assets.assessment: Accepted after visual inspection. Strong cheap semi-dirty venue identity, low yellowed ceiling, storage along edges, colorful stackable plastic chairs, open orange door into existing-style party room, second closed door and clear center. Folding tables and cylinder have somewhat stronger wear than the reference, appropriate to the staff storage function. Floor has dull linoleum sheen, no visible water.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one landscape 1536x1024 concept frame for a modular Blender/Roblox horror level.
Primary request: Design a NEW caretaker's maintenance workshop immediately behind the children's party maze in the reference images. Preserve its ordinary semi-dirty, inexpensive late-1990s birthday venue inside an aging middle/lower-income mall. Make a convincing, memorable little backroom, with better materials and spatial composition but no upscale makeover.
Input images 1 and 2 are visual identity references, NOT edit targets. Borrow the cheap beige and orange palette, low oppressive ceiling, plain boxy architecture and colorful plastic chairs. Create a new camera view and room. Absolutely no screenshot HUD.
Scene: a small cramped-looking but readily passable staff utility workshop. Left wall has an old simple wooden workbench with a metal vise, a short sparse pegboard holding a few ordinary hand tools, worn mismatched plastic parts drawers beneath, and a single used red one-piece molded plastic party chair. Right wall has a compact gray electrical breaker box, exposed simple conduit and a single ventilation duct, plus a plain metal shelf holding spare rectangular fluorescent fixtures and modest maintenance supplies. At front right sits a dirty yellow wheeled mop bucket, EMPTY and dry, with mop leaned against wall. Avoid excessive machinery or tiny clutter.
The open center stays clear for a player. At the rear a plain ajar orange service door reveals a sliver of the neighboring dark children's confetti carpet and flat fluorescent party-room ceiling. A small faded paper birthday decoration has been casually taped near an old cheap wall clock above the workbench, tying the room back to the cheap venue. Plain geometry, practical small-room proportions, possible modular doorway connection.
Materials: faded and locally flaking beige paint over block/plaster walls, black vinyl skirting, patched dull gray linoleum with edge dirt, very low yellowed acoustic ceiling with a few surface conduits. Honest ordinary wear, scuffs and tape marks; not extreme dereliction.
Camera: human eye level, moderately wide 27mm-like view from the entrance across the bench toward the rear door. One coherent landscape scene. A weak warm workbench lamp meets cold flat fluorescent ceiling light; keep all key shapes readable. Moderately stylized polished 3D indie-horror game/Blender concept, chunky reusable assets, medium detail, restrained wear, not a real-estate photograph.
Avoid: big industrial plant, steampunk pipe maze, elegant hotel/service suite, upscale architecture, high ceilings, cove lighting, marble, palms, shiny glossy luxury surfaces, fog, pitch black, water/puddles/aquariums/fountains, people, monsters, gore, captions, HUD, logos, watermarks, split screen or collage.
assets.assessment: Accepted after visual inspection. Compact beige workshop with ordinary workbench and vise, sparse pegboard, worn drawers, red party chair, duct, breaker box, spare fluorescent fixtures and dry mop bucket. Orange open door frames confetti-carpet party room. Birthday paper decoration connects functions. Clear floor route, readable fluorescent lighting, no luxury/industrial-plant drift, no water or characters. This is concept art, not built Roblox geometry.
